thread:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] api-prod gateway 5xx spike > baseline. From dashboards: 502/504 and upstream timeouts. Correlation shows elevated errors around kv-prefix cache activity and increased KV latency. spike_start=03:12 UTC, error_rate=4.8% (baseline ~0.03%).
Maya: ack. Paging @Jordan (oncall) and @Li for runtime context. @Priya can you check CS for customer reports? :rotating_light:
Jordan: I'm on call. grabbing initial logs and metrics. taking ownership. ETA 10-15m.
Li: adding context — we rolled prefetch tuning (prefetch_window=128 -> 512) in 1.23.4 at 02:58 across prod; also a GC job for shard consolidation ran ~03:05. Possible interaction.
Alex: are we seeing checksum errors or null reads? those have shown up before when prefix index drifted.
Jordan: seeing both. quick grep from kv-cache pod:
```
ERROR kv/prefix_index.go:412 checksum mismatch prefix=0x7f3a shard=7 expected=0x1a2b got=0x0
WARN kv/cache.go:221 null-read for prefix 0x7f3a keylen=42 origin=origin-svc
ERROR upstream/gateway.go:87 502 Bad Gateway: upstream timeout
```
Jordan: current plan: 1) enable prefix cache bypass for a fraction of traffic 2) disable prefetch to reduce background load 3) scale cache pool +2 nodes and isolate shard 7 for reindexing. doing steps 1-2 now.
Maya: noted. Priya, are any large customers alerting? need customer impact details for oncall escalation.
Priya: CS summary: 12 customers with elevated errors, top 3 impacted: ACME (8% fails), NovaCorp (5%), Metricly (3.5%). ACME support case opened, CS has mitigation steps to route them to dedicated region if needed. alerting customers 1:1.
PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Jordan. Pager duty page sent to SRE rotation.
Jordan: toggling feature flag to bypass prefix cache for 20% of traffic to reduce downstream pressure.
```
# feature flag rollout (internal CLI)
redwood ff set prefix_cache_bypass --env=prod --percent=20 --comment "live mitigation - oncall"
```
Jordan: done. Now disabling prefetch in configmap and rolling kv-cache pods.
```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/kv-cache PREFETCH_ENABLED=false
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/kv-cache
```
Li: reindexing job queued for shard 7, running in isolated mode. command:
```
redwood kv reindex --shard=7 --mode=isolate --concurrent=2
```
Alex: starting temporary scaling: +2 cache instances on pool-prod-caches.
Jordan: scaled. live metrics after bypass+prefetch-disable (5m window): error_rate -> 0.9% (was 4.8%). 502s dropped 70%, upstream timeouts reduced. continuing to ramp.
Maya: good. Start progressive rollout of bypass to 100% if stable. note: bypass increases origin load, watch origin latency.
Jordan: ramping bypass to 50% now.
```
redwood ff set prefix_cache_bypass --env=prod --percent=50
```
Jordan: after 12 minutes post-ramp: error_rate -> 0.5%. ACME reports partial recovery, NovaCorp improving. still seeing isolated errors from shard 7 path. reindex job at 18% complete.
Priya: CS update sent to affected customers, included ETA of 45m for full mitigation and suggested workarounds. PRD@ACME acknowledged.
Li: reindex finished for shard 7. checksums reconciled, no further null-reads in that shard. running consistency check across neighbor shards.
Jordan: ran quick consistency check and saw success. rolling bypass from 50% -> 100% to remove prefix-cache routing entirely while we validate reindex across cluster.
```
redwood ff set prefix_cache_bypass --env=prod --percent=100
```
Jordan: bypass 100% applied. error_rate now 0.12% and baseline slowly recovering. origin latency increased ~12% but within SLOs. will keep cache pool scaled until further notice.
Maya: handing off to eng-runtime to root cause the root cause (prefetch tuning + gc + reindex interaction). Jordan, please create a timeline and add logs for postmortem. Priya, make sure CS has follow-ups scheduled.
Jordan: creating postmortem draft and will attach logs and commands used. assigning owners: eng-runtime for bug, eng-platform for safer FF runbooks, SRE for mitigation playbook updates.
Alex: nice work. small follow-ups: 1) add automated alert for checksum-mismatch rate per shard, 2) safe-rollout guard when prefetch window change + shard consolidation detected.
Maya: agreed. will add to action items. turning this thread into an incident ticket and scheduling a 1hr war room tomorrow for RCA.
PagerDuty: Incident is on the record. Incident severity set to Sev2. Next update in 20m or on status change. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: oncall handoff to next shift @04:30 UTC. leaving mitigation in place and owners assigned. if anything flips, page me.
Maya: thanks team. end of live mitigation for now — moving to post-incident RCA phase. :pray:
